draft.heroMessage: Local Expertise, Personalized Service—The Right Realtor® Gets the Right Results.
draft.welcomeNote: Welcome! At Woods N Water Real Estate, we believe in making your real estate journey as stress-free and rewarding as possible. I'm Valerie J Streeter, dedicated to serving the Manistique Lakes area and here to help you reach your property goals.
draft.tagline: Trusted Real Estate Guidance in Curtis & the Manistique Lakes Area
draft.aboutParagraph: Since 2005, Woods N Water Real Estate has proudly helped buyers and sellers throughout Curtis and the Manistique Lakes region. As Broker/Owner, I bring hands-on experience and a deep connection to this area, focusing on attentive client service and local market knowledge. Repeat clients and word-of-mouth referrals are at the heart of our business, and I strive to ensure that every interaction is professional, friendly, and thorough. Whether you're searching for a new home, selling your property, or simply seeking expert guidance, I'm here to help you achieve the right result.
draft.conciergeLine: Looking for local insight? Let’s talk about your goals—call or email any time.
draft.contactLine: Reach out directly at 906-235-1288 or valstreeter@sbcglobal.net.
draft.tone: warm, approachable, and community-focused, with an emphasis on one-on-one service and deep local roots.

ABOUT
The Right Realtor® Gets the Right Results
We strive to make the process of either buying or selling property as stress free as possible with our friendly and knowledgeable sales staff.
FROM THE SITE
Financing requirements.
Lenders typically look at your credit history, credit score, debt to income ratio, and how long you have had the same job to determine your eligibility for certain loan programs. The higher your credit score and the better your credit history, the more favorable the terms. But even if you have poor credit, it doesn’t mean that you won’t qualify for a home loan. There are several options available even with low down payment, down payment assistance programs, and grants.
